items.title: find_or_create_stub: lookup-before-create entry point for all 4 stub-creation paths
items.summary: Lookup-before-create entry point built on resolve_all (WI-018). Replaces ad-hoc create_stub calls scattered across 4 paths (orchestrator contact_normalizer + contact-detector + HAL9000 entities + exocortex Granola ingester). Cascade: get_by_email → get_by_phone → resolve_all with company hint at threshold ≥0.85 → fall through to create_stub. Identifier write-back: on reuse, if call supplied new email/phone not on canonical, append and save. || DONE 2026-06-01: 5 tests added test-first (all fail pre-fix, all pass post-fix), part of the 14-test WI-018+WI-019 batch in commit ec4393a. Caller migration NOT in this commit — sequenced as follow-on per orchestrator/docs/find-or-create-stub.md.

items.title: PersonRepository.resolve_all() — multi-candidate ranked resolve with company-hint disambiguation
items.summary: Existing resolve() returns Optional[Person] — single match, stops at first cascade hit. resolve_all returns List[ResolveCandidate] with all plausible matches ranked by confidence. New strategies: token-subset matching (≥2 shared tokens in either direction; catches 'Emily Mendes' ⊆ 'Emily Mendes Speechmatics'), short-form 'First L' partial-match. Company-hint bump: +0.25 confidence (capped 1.0) when canonical's company matches OR canonical's name contains the company token (catches mangled-stub case where company got concatenated into name). Email match runs before alias to win label tie-breaking. || DONE 2026-06-01: 9 tests added test-first (all fail pre-fix, all pass post-fix), part of the 14-test batch in commit ec4393a. Foundation for WI-019 find_or_create_stub.

items.title: PersonRepository.create_stub: parse RFC 2822 sender strings before regex-sanitizing the name
items.summary: create_stub at person.py:380 regex-strips non-word/whitespace/hyphen chars from the name arg. When the caller passes a raw RFC 2822 sender field ('Display Name <email@domain>'), the regex strips <, >, @, . — leaving 'Display Name emailatdomaincom' as the canonical name AND filename. Production vault: 62 corrupted notes match this pattern. Surfaced 2026-06-01 from orchestrator/WI-102 dedupe review (e.g. @David Agmen-Smith davidasspeechmaticscom.md). Fix: add email.utils.parseaddr defensive parse at top of create_stub — extracts email from <...>, uses display-name part (or email local-part) as the name. Caller's explicit email arg wins if passed. || DONE 2026-06-01: 9 edge-case tests written test-first (5 fail on pre-fix state, 4 no-op pass). Fix shipped: 7 LOC. All 9 tests pass post-fix. Full tests/test_repositories.py (114 tests) green — zero regressions. Retroactive cleanup of the 62 corrupted vault notes is a separate orchestrator-side disposable script (not in this WI's scope).

items.title: Incremental Loading
items.summary: The `refresh()` method reloads everything — every file gets re-parsed regardless of whether it changed. For a vault with hundreds of entity files, this is wasteful when only a few files were modified

items.title: Index Persistence
items.summary: Every time a repository is instantiated, it rebuilds its indexes from scratch by parsing every markdown file in the vault. For large vaults this is slow — startup time scales linearly with file count.
